display_name: Osa-AK battery: march, short halt, combat formation and halts
status: Numbers for simcore/battery.hpp (roadmap 7.5). The tactics are from an unnamed manual retold in video_osa (tier 4, unverified, consistent with Soviet practice; docs/research/OSA_RESEARCH_2026-10.md §7). Where a range is given, the middle is used; speeds are estimates.
notes: Composition (flak11): battery commander's PU-12M, two platoons of two 9A33 and one TZM, a maintenance vehicle. Ambush (several prepared points, or pairs roving between them; bounding in pairs as the covered force advances) and river crossing (about 2 km from the river, then across in pairs once the far bank is held) are from video_osa too.

march_spacing_m.source: video_osa (25-50 m between vehicles on the march)

threat_spacing_m.source: video_osa (200-800 m when an air attack is expected)

march_speed_mps.source: mon_2112_80 p11 (dirt roads 30 km/h; road up to 60); korovin_tiv_2010 (dirt roads 36 km/h by day, 25 at night): 30 km/h for a column

short_halt_offset_m.source: estimate (off the road far enough to deploy, alternating sides); video_osa (ready to pull off the road for a short-halt engagement at any time)

deploy_s.source: mon_2112_80 p11-12 (readiness within 4 min); video_osa (a powered battery deploys in 35-50 s, unverified): the documented 4 min is used for an NPC vehicle

pair_separation_m.source: video_osa (vehicles in pairs about 3 km apart in the combat formation)

behind_covered_m.source: video_osa (1.5-3 km behind the covered unit)

reload_behind_m.source: video_osa (reload vehicles about 500 m from the pairs)

command_post_behind_m.source: estimate (the battery command post behind the pairs; video_osa places the PU-12 at the head or tail of a march column)

halt_interval_s.source: video_osa (halts every 3-4 h: equipment check, fuel, food)

halt_duration_s.source: video_osa (rest up to 2 h); 1.5 h used

night_halt_s.source: video_osa (at night shorter halts of about 1 h without breaking formation)

warning_s.source: flak11 (preliminary preparation from cold: 3.8 min switch-on and 3.0 min function check, 6.8 min)
warning_s.notes: The warning the launchers need: the NPC battery commander raises readiness when the board shows a track that will reach the edge of the zone in this time or less (simcore/board_reading.hpp). Without a speed (one mark) the threat range below decides.

zone_edge_m.source: flak11 (Osa-AK engagement zone head-on to 10 km)
zone_edge_m.notes: Where the warning time is counted to: the far edge of the launchers' zone, from the battery.

threat_range_m.source: samsim_osa p21 (the crew waits until a target approaches the 50 km circle): a designated target inside this makes the battery open the column (sam3d)

water_speed_mps.source: mon_2112_80 p11, flak11 (9K33-0), nuou (8 km/h in water)

river_standoff_m.source: video_osa (river crossing: positions about 2 km from the river; cross in pairs once the far bank is held)

ambush_dwell_s.source: estimate (pairs roving between prepared ambush points: video_osa gives the drill, not the time at each point)

alongside_offset_m.source: estimate (the TZM parks beside the launcher, its crane over the containers: flak11)

tzm_capacity.source: estimate (a TZM is usually credited with two loads of six missiles; flak11 gives six in 6 min per load; not checked against a document)

fuel_truck_capacity_l.source: estimate (an ATZ-3.8 tanker: 3.8 m3 by its designation)
